title: Your month, at a glance
summary: A compact matrix that keeps the whole duty readable.
steps: Saved opening months appear first; remaining history loads afterward. Return from another app to the same position on the same day. Swipe across dates; the month header follows the visible month.
Tap a flight number for details, or a purple report time for an FDP scenario.
Read each day’s FLT footer. Overnight sectors count in full on their arrival date.

title: More days with one rotation
summary: The same narrow columns, with more room across the screen.
steps: Rotate your phone to landscape. Your visible date stays in view.
The top controls disappear to give the roster more vertical space.
Return to portrait to access Settings and the toolbar.

title: Compare with the published roster
summary: Latest above, Original below. Both move together.
steps: Open Settings → Roster comparison and select a month.
Scroll horizontally to compare the same dates; scroll vertically for longer duties.
Light amber marks changed past days. Originals are preserved locally.

title: Spot upcoming changes
summary: Stronger amber brings today’s and future changes into focus.
steps: The website’s published roster is preferred as Original.
When unavailable, the first full-month download is a clearly labelled fallback.
Compare daily and monthly UTC elapsed durations. Turning comparison off preserves saved data.

title: Open one month or several
summary: Combine saved months without downloading them again.
steps: Open Saved Rosters from the clock-arrow toolbar button.
Select the months you want to join, or use Current month + next.
Swipe a saved period to delete it. A new sync replaces that period’s latest copy.

title: One flight, one clear card
summary: Route, local and UTC times, aircraft, gate and passenger information.
steps: Tap the flight number in the matrix.
Swipe to another flight in the same duty.
PAX, gate, registration and crew reflect the last roster sync; weather refresh is separate.

title: Put names and countries together
summary: Roster-supplied crew details with compact nationality flags.
steps: Open the crew section in flight details.
Tap a flag to see the country name and a larger flag.
Country labels come from the roster website, not an inference from someone’s name.

title: Training and other duties
summary: A condensed card for duties that are not flight sectors.
steps: Tap a duty such as PC or RT in the matrix.
Read the available schedule, location and participants.
Crew and other fields appear only when the roster website supplies them.

title: Airport reminders, one tap away
summary: Compact public airport facts and available procedure reminders.
steps: Tap the origin or destination airport code on a flight card.
Switch between departure and arrival information.
Use these dated reminders to locate official information, never as current operational procedures.

title: Read the full weather report
summary: METAR and TAF remain separate from roster synchronization.
steps: Tap a weather summary in flight details.
Inspect the full report and its issue, observation and validity times.
Refresh weather independently. The sample report pictured here is fictional, not live weather.

title: Understand weather highlights
summary: Know what the app flags—and what those flags cannot establish.
steps: Open Weather alert rules from flight details.
Review the visibility, ceiling, wind and significant-weather thresholds.
These highlights are incomplete attention aids, not a briefing or aircraft operating limits.

title: Explore an FDP scenario
summary: The report and arrival wheels show the time gap to a table-based endpoint.
steps: Tap a purple report time in the roster.
Adjust report or arrival using the wheels; toggle LOCAL/UTC for reference.
Add one sector for a scenario, then RESET TIMES TO ROSTER to clear all overrides. HKCAD Table A only.

title: A reminder for one duty
summary: Set a named notification relative to that duty’s report time.
steps: Open the report reminder link from Flight Details.
For zero days, choose a lead time in 15-minute steps—even if it crosses midnight.
For one or more days, choose the earlier date and local time of day. Check the calculated reminder time.

title: Make reminders a habit
summary: Apply a general timing rule to saved future report times.
steps: Open the bell, then the general reminder option.
Choose a rule such as 1:30 before, or two days before at 09:00.
Allow iOS notifications and review them after roster changes. Delivery still depends on device settings.

title: Find time together
summary: A minimal shared roster, with names and your own row kept visible.
steps: Pair through mutual QR sharing; scan with the camera or select a QR image.
Scroll across dates and down people. Tap multiple dates to highlight columns.
Edit nicknames locally, or stop sharing with a selected friend. Checks run once per app launch or on Refresh.

title: Share a printable roster
summary: A clean monthly matrix with the owner’s name beneath the title.
steps: Open Settings → Sharing.
Choose current month, or current and next month when available.
Preview the PDF, then use Share to choose a destination or Print. Share only where authorized.

title: Move your saved history
summary: Transfer roster data between app instances without another website sync.
steps: Open Settings → Import / export roster backup.
Save the file, then Import and merge in the destination app.
Credentials, reminders, preferences and separate Original snapshots are not transferred. Protect personal roster files.

title: Export to PILOTLOG
summary: Prepare a compatible CSV and inspect the import preview.
steps: Set the airline’s two-character code in Settings.
Choose the date range and prepare the PILOTLOG export.
Use PILOTLOG’s Import Wizard. Review inferred roles, instrument time, night estimates and assumed landings.

title: Export to LogTen
summary: A separate export format with the same reviewable roster fields.
steps: Choose Export to LogTen Pro in Settings.
On LogTen for Mac, use File → Import from File → Flights.
Check field mappings and automatic recalculation settings. A roster export is not a verified logbook.

title: Choose what Sync means
summary: Set your normal download scope and retrieve past months on demand.
steps: Choose current month or current + next under Sync Preferences.
On the main roster, pull firmly until Release to sync appears.
Use Download Past Rosters for a selected month or the past 12 months. Next month appears only when available.

title: Make the display yours
summary: Light, Dark or Follow Device, with the familiar roster colors.
steps: Choose your appearance in Settings.
Set whether opening the app places today at the left edge.
Choose current + next month or full saved history without deleting older months.

title: Start with your own roster website
summary: Save your authorized connection details and start the first sync.
steps: Read the usage notices, then enter the HTTPS roster website, Crew ID and password.
Choose Save and Sync and authenticate on your device.
Keep the app open; if the website requests verification, use Connection and Resume.

title: Help that travels with you
summary: Search the same guide inside the app, even while offline.
steps: Open Settings → Help & gestures.
Search for a gesture, tool or task.
Open a topic for detailed steps. The website guide uses the same source content.

title: Keep official sources first
summary: Clear limitations, privacy information and support.
steps: Read the usage notices before getting started.
Use Settings → About for notices, privacy and support.
The app is for entertainment only, not official operational documents or duty-legality decisions.

title: Check the departure ATIS
summary: Available Hong Kong departure runways, independently of roster sync.
steps: Open the departure ATIS link from flight details.
Check the report time, runway wording and full text. The report pictured is fictional.
A published ATIS runway is not a forecast or clearance for your flight. Verify the current official broadcast.

title: Choose what to share
summary: Create a PDF from saved data without another sync.
steps: Open Settings → Sharing.
Select Current month or Current + next month.
Tap Share roster PDF, review the preview, then choose Share or Print.
